_comment: Tool-to-capability mapping for the hook feasibility matrix (ADR-0503, phase 00).
A committed TABLE, not a heuristic. A tool may map to more than one capability, so every
DEFAULT-DENY AT THE SERVER LEVEL, and this is the load-bearing part: each server carries a
`default` capability set applied to every tool NOT listed under `tools`. The default is the
conservative union of what that server can reach, so a tool nobody has enumerated is
treated as the most dangerous thing its server can do -- never as harmless. A server absent
from this file makes policy-matrix exit 2 rather than guessing, which mirrors argv0_classes
(ADR-0507): deny-by-default applied to classification itself, in both places, for the same
